Assign to the frontend team if the system component is interface and the reproducible status is consistent. If the system component is network and the severity level is critical, assign to the infrastructure team. If the system component is documentation, assign to the technical writing team. Return a list of team assignments. For example, a consistent critical database issue goes to the hotfix team.

title: Dietary Meal Planner
spec: Select a banquet meal option for event attendees with `plan(guests)`. Each guest object has a dietary restriction, a protein preference, and an age group. Serve the vegan plate if the dietary restriction is plant based. Serve the standard steak if the dietary restriction is none, the protein preference is beef, and the age group is adult. Serve the mild chicken if the dietary restriction is none and the age group is child. If the dietary restriction is gluten free and the protein preference is fish, serve the baked salmon. If the dietary restriction is gluten free and the protein preference is beef, serve the grilled steak. If the dietary restriction is dairy free and the protein preference is poultry, serve the roasted bird. If the dietary restriction is nut allergy, serve the safe kitchen prep. Return a list of meal options. For example, an adult with no restrictions and beef preference gets standard steak.

title: Forestry Timber Evaluator
spec: Classify trees for potential harvesting via `evaluate(trees)`. Each tree has a species category, a trunk health, and a canopy density. Mark for prime harvest if the species category is hardwood, the trunk health is solid, and the canopy density is thick. Mark for culling if the trunk health is diseased regardless of species. If the species category is softwood, mark for standard harvest if the trunk health is solid and the canopy density is moderate. Mark for conservation if the canopy density is sparse and the trunk health is solid. If the species category is invasive, mark for immediate removal. If the species category is hardwood and the trunk health is hollow, mark for wildlife reserve. If the species category is softwood and the canopy density is thick, mark for prime harvest. Return an array of harvest classifications. For example, a solid hardwood with a thick canopy gets marked for prime harvest.

title: Customer Support Router
spec: Direct incoming customer service requests to the correct department using `route(tickets)`. Each ticket has a contact channel, a customer tier, and an issue category. Route to priority phone support if the customer tier is platinum and the contact channel is voice. Route to technical billing if the issue category is invoice and the customer tier is gold. If the contact channel is chat and the issue category is password, route to automated recovery. Route to general email if the contact channel is text and the customer tier is standard. If the contact channel is social media, route to public relations. If the customer tier is platinum and the issue category is refund, route to the retention team. If the customer tier is silver and the contact channel is voice, route to standard phone support. Return a list of department destinations. For example, a voice ticket from a platinum customer goes to priority phone support.

title: Disaster Relief Allocator
spec: Distribute emergency supplies to affected areas via `allocate(regions)`. Each region has a damage assessment, an infrastructure status, and a population density. Send air drops if the infrastructure status is destroyed and the population density is high. Send ground convoys if the infrastructure status is passable and the damage assessment is severe. If the infrastructure status is destroyed and the population density is low, send helicopter scouts. Send standard relief if the damage assessment is moderate and the infrastructure status is passable. If the infrastructure status is flooded and the population density is high, send boat rescue. If the infrastructure status is flooded and the population density is low, send boat scouts. If the damage assessment is minimal, assign monitoring. Return a list of distribution methods for each region. For example, a severely damaged area with passable roads receives ground convoys.

title: Film Casting Matcher
spec: Filter audition candidates for specific movie roles with `cast(actors)`. Each actor has a vocal range, a physical build, and a stunt certification. Cast as the protagonist if the vocal range is tenor, the physical build is athletic, and the stunt certification is active. Cast as the antagonist if the vocal range is bass and the physical build is imposing. If the stunt certification is expired, cast as a background extra unless the physical build is athletic, in which case cast as a stunt double trainee. Cast as a supporting role if the vocal range is alto and the stunt certification is active. If the vocal range is soprano and the physical build is petite, cast as the lead vocalist. If the vocal range is baritone and the physical build is imposing, cast as the supporting antagonist. Return an array of roles. For example, an athletic tenor with active certification gets the protagonist role.

title: Financial Loan Underwriter
spec: Determine the approval status for personal loans using `underwrite(applications)`. Each application has a credit standing, a collateral type, and an employment status. Approve instantly if the credit standing is excellent and the employment status is salaried. Approve conditionally if the credit standing is good and the collateral type is real estate. Deny outright if the credit standing is poor and the employment status is unemployed. If the employment status is self employed, pend for review unless the credit standing is excellent and the collateral type is liquid assets, which gets approved instantly. If the credit standing is fair and the collateral type is vehicle, approve conditionally. If the credit standing is poor but the employment status is salaried, pend for review. Return a list of loan decisions. For example, excellent credit and salaried employment returns approve instantly.

title: Marine Vessel Navigator
spec: Assign harbor docking procedures for incoming ships via `navigate(vessels)`. Each vessel has a ship class, a cargo type, and a hull integrity. Assign the deep water pier if the ship class is freighter and the hull integrity is intact. Assign the quarantine anchorage if the cargo type is hazardous and the hull integrity is compromised. If the ship class is passenger, assign the terminal dock if the hull integrity is intact, but assign the emergency slip if the hull integrity is compromised. Assign the commercial wharf if the ship class is fishing and the cargo type is perishable. If the ship class is military and the hull integrity is intact, assign the naval base. If the ship class is yacht and the hull integrity is intact, assign the marina. Return a list of assigned locations. For example, an intact freighter gets the deep water pier.

title: Intellectual Property Classifier
spec: Categorize patent and trademark applications using `classify(submissions)`. Each submission has an asset type, a novelty status, and an industry sector. Grant expedited review if the asset type is patent, the novelty status is groundbreaking, and the industry sector is medical. Route to standard review if the asset type is patent and the novelty status is iterative. Reject outright if the novelty status is derivative and the asset type is trademark. If the industry sector is software, route to technical review unless the asset type is copyright, which goes to administrative review. If the asset type is design and the industry sector is consumer, route to aesthetic review. If the asset type is trade secret, route to secure vault review regardless of novelty. Return a list of review categories. For example, a groundbreaking medical patent gets expedited review.
